description: This file defines extension methods for the ISerializerBuilder interface in the Orleans.Serialization namespace, allowing configuration of serialization options and assembly addition.

classes.name: SerializerBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for configuring and augmenting ISerializerBuilder instances.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Adds a configuration delegate for TypeManifestOptions to the serialization builder, using a factory function.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Adds a predefined IConfigureOptions<TypeManifestOptions> to the serialization builder.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures TypeManifestOptions on the builder via a configuration action.

methods.name: AddAssembly
methods.description: Associates an assembly with the builder by adding relevant configuration providers based on custom attributes.
